name: Calendars
intro: **Everything is arithmetic modulo 7.** An "odd day" is the remainder left after removing whole weeks, and the whole topic is bookkeeping on those remainders (§1).
The four anchors worth memorising: 100 years → 5 odd days, 200 → 3, 300 → 1, 400 → 0. A century year is a leap year only if divisible by 400.

qs.q: How many odd days are there in 100 years?
qs.h: §2 — 100 years contain 24 leap years and 76 ordinary ones (1900-type century years are not leap).

qs.q: The number of odd days in 400 years is
qs.h: §2 — the calendar repeats exactly every 400 years, which is precisely what this says.
qs.s: 5 + 5 + 5 + 6 = 21 ≡ 0 (mod 7). (The fourth century contributes 6 because its century year is a leap year.)

qs.q: How many odd days are there in 300 years?
qs.h: §2 — three lots of 5.

qs.q: A leap year contains how many odd days?
qs.h: §2 — 366 = 52 weeks + 2 days.

qs.q: How many odd days does February contribute in a leap year?
qs.h: §3 — 29 days is four weeks plus one.

qs.q: The number of odd days from 1 January 2001 to 31 December 2010 is
qs.h: §2 — ten years, of which 2004 and 2008 are leap.

sets.name: The day of the week for a given date

qs.q: 15 August 1947 was a
qs.h: §4 — 1600 years (0) + 300 years (1) + 46 years + the days up to 15 August 1947.

qs.q: 1 January 2024 was a Monday. How many days after Monday is 1 January 2025? (Enter 0 for Monday, 1 for Tuesday, and so on.)
qs.h: §2 — 2024 is a leap year, so it contributes 2 odd days, not 1.

qs.q: 26 January 1950 was a
qs.h: §4 — work from 1 January 1950, then add the 25 intervening days.

qs.q: 5 March 2023 was a Sunday. How many days after Sunday is 5 March 2024? (Enter 0 for Sunday.)
qs.h: §2 — the span contains 29 February 2024, so it is 366 days, not 365.
qs.s: 366 mod 7 = 2 ⟹ Tuesday ⟹ 2. (Assuming 365 gives Monday — the planted error.)

qs.q: 1 January 2000 was a
qs.h: §4 — 1600 contributes 0 odd days, 300 years contribute 1, and 99 years contribute the rest.

qs.q: The calendar for 2007 was the same as the calendar for
qs.h: §5 — accumulate odd days year by year from 2007 until the running total is a multiple of 7.
qs.s: 2007–2012 contribute 1+1+2+1+1+1 … running to 7 by the end of 2017 ⟹ the calendar repeats in 2018.

qs.q: The calendar for 1993 is the same as that for which year?
qs.h: §5 — sum the odd days of 1993, 1994, … until they total 7.

qs.q: A leap year's calendar repeats after
qs.h: §5 — a leap year has to line up with both the 7-day and the 4-year cycles.
qs.s: LCM-type reasoning gives 28 years (away from century-year exceptions).

qs.q: 2016 was a leap year. In which year will its calendar repeat?
qs.h: §5 — apply the 28-year rule; no century exception intervenes here.

sets.name: Counting weekdays and days between dates

qs.q: How many days are there from 1 March 2023 to 15 June 2023, both inclusive?
qs.h: §7 — add the whole months, then the partial one. Inclusive counting means the first day counts too.

qs.q: The maximum number of Sundays that can occur in a 30-day month is
qs.h: §6 — 30 days is four weeks plus two, so at most two weekdays occur five times.

qs.q: How many Sundays are there in a non-leap year that begins on a Sunday?
qs.h: §6 — 365 days is 52 weeks plus one extra day, and that extra day is the one that repeats.
qs.s: 52 weeks give 52 Sundays, and the extra day is also a Sunday ⟹ 53.

qs.q: The number of days from 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2024, both inclusive, is
qs.h: §2 — 2024 is divisible by 4 and is not a century year.

qs.q: A 31-day month begins on a Friday. How many Fridays does it contain?
qs.h: §6 — 31 days is four weeks plus three, so the first three weekdays of the month occur five times.
qs.s: Friday, Saturday and Sunday each occur five times ⟹ 5 Fridays.

qs.q: 1 January 2026 falls on a
qs.h: Step forward from a date you know.
qs.s: 1 Jan 2024 was a Monday; 2024 is leap (+2) ⟹ 1 Jan 2025 Wednesday; 2025 is ordinary (+1) ⟹ 1 Jan 2026 is a Thursday.

qs.q: How many odd days are there in 200 years?
qs.h: Two lots of 5.

qs.q: If today is Wednesday, the day 100 days from now will be
qs.h: Reduce 100 modulo 7.

qs.q: 29 February 2024 was a Thursday. How many days after Thursday is 29 February 2028? (Enter 0 for Thursday.)
qs.h: Count the days across the four years; exactly one 29 February falls strictly inside the span.

qs.q: The last day of a century cannot be a
qs.h: The 400-year cycle allows only four possible weekdays for a century's last day.
qs.s: Only Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday are possible ⟹ it cannot be a Wednesday.

qs.q: A non-leap year begins on a Wednesday. How many Wednesdays does it contain?
qs.h: The single odd day repeats the starting weekday.

qs.q: The calendar for 2005 is the same as the calendar for
qs.h: Accumulate odd days until the total reaches 7.

qs.q: How many days are there from 15 March 2024 to 20 May 2024, both inclusive?
qs.h: Partial month, whole month, partial month.

audit: forgetting that 1700, 1800 and 1900 are not leap years, which is what makes 100 years give 5 rather than 6 (§2)
counting a leap year as 1 odd day, or missing that a March-to-March span crosses 29 February (§2)
counting the leap years in the wrong window
mishandling the century anchor, or forgetting the days elapsed within the final year (§4)
adding a fixed 6 or 11 years instead of accumulating odd days to a multiple of 7 (§5)
off-by-one from inclusive counting — the first day counts (§7)
assuming every weekday occurs the same number of times; the surplus days decide which repeat (§6)
counting the wrong number of 29 Februarys inside the span
not knowing that only four weekdays are possible for the last day of a century
